Fancy a last-minute summer holiday – or looking for some autumn sun? Check out our list of our top picks for late summer and sunny autumn trips for the UK, Europe and beyond.
If you’re looking for sun but don’t want to deal with a long flight – or even don’t want to fly at all – we’ve got some great European spots to choose from.
With its southern location in the Mediterranean and Aegean seas, Greece can hold onto the warmer weather for longer than lots of other Europe holiday spots.
If you want a cultural city break, Athens offers rich history and fantastic food.
For more relaxed breaks, Kos and Crete have beautiful beaches to lounge on and stunning waters to swim in.
While northern and central France can get some cloudier and colder weather as autumn rolls around, the south of the country is still a top choice for a sunny holiday.
If you’re looking for amazing food, lively ports and relaxing beaches, give Marseille and Nice a try.
There’s also plenty of history to explore in the south of France, like Marseille’s Notre-Dame de la Garde.
Like southern France, southern Spain has some gorgeous coastal locations that can make for a perfect late summer or autumn sunny trip.
From Mallorca or Costa Blanca to the Canary Islands, there’s so many stunning beaches and sights.
Off the coast of southern Italy are the gorgeous islands of Malta.
Surrounded by crisp blue waters and blue skies, it’s a great choice for late summer or autumn holidays.
You can either enjoy the bustle of Valletta, check out some of the rich history and architecture, or chill out on Gozo’s beaches – whatever suits you!
Located off the south coast of Turkey, Cyprus is the perfect spot for an autumn sun getaway.
Whether you’re looking for a chill resort or a busy city trip, this sunny island is a popular holiday destination among Brits.
Fancy going further afield for your late sun holiday? There are even more destinations to choose from.
Australia is known for its year-round sun, which is just as enjoyable in autumn as it is in summer.
Coastal cities like Sydney and Queensland have a great mixture of culture, entertainment and beaches.
You can also enjoy tours of the wildlife if you want to reconnect with nature – or go snorkelling off the coast to see Australia’s marine life.
If you’re looking for gorgeous beaches and breath-taking views, Thailand might be the perfect spot for you.
The country has many photo-worthy beaches, including the famous Patong Beach in Phuket.
The nation is also famous for its incredible food and rich history, so you can mix things up with some city exploring and restaurant hopping.
With a similar climate to Thailand but on the other side of the world, Brazil is a nation known for its dense rainforests, but that’s not all it offers.
Beaches, resorts, hikes, history – the list is endless. Whether you want to get stuck into the culture or kick back on a sun lounger, Brazil could be right for you.
If you’ve budgeted for a more luxurious holiday in a quieter spot, you might want to consider the paradise islands of the Maldives.
The Maldives has become famous for its white sands and crisp, clear waters, not to mention its unique over-water villas that stretch along the coast.
If it’s the high life you’re looking for, the Maldives can offer it.
If you’re in the market for a staycation instead, check out our picks for the UK and Channel Islands’ best autumn sun destinations.
Located off the coast of northern France, this Channel Island nation has a unique mix of British and French culture.
With beaches, nature walks and even a zoo, Jersey can be a great choice for a late summer holiday that’s not too far away.
With some of the best beaches on the mainland UK, Cornwall is a popular choice for summer and autumn trips.
It’s also a great place for water sports if you want a more active and adventurous trip on the coast.
Another of the Channel Islands, Guernsey is a little closer to the British mainland but can still make for a great late sun holiday.
Guernsey has lots of gorgeous countryside, as well as serene coastal views and walks.
Whether you want to take a boat trip around the island or explore some of the nation’s history, Guernsey has what you’re looking for.
Nestled in the south of England, Dorset is one of Britain’s famous coastal beauty spots, with some gorgeous bays, rock formations and beaches to enjoy.
You can also stroll through Dorset’s sleepy villages, drive through the peaceful countryside or grab lunch in one of its many traditional pubs.
Yes. Lots of insurers offer last-minute travel cover if you decide to book a spontaneous trip.
You can buy travel insurance even as late as when you’re at the airport waiting to head off, as long as you haven’t gone through customs yet.
But ideally, you should book travel insurance at the same time you book your trip.
Most insurers – including us - won’t cover you if you try to take out a travel policy during your trip.
